description: This PHP source file defines the `Info` class within the `Goteo\Model` namespace. The class handles data retrieval, listing, validation, and saving operations for informational entries, including related media and image gallery management.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: Represents and manages 'information' entries in the application, including fetching data, listing entries, validation, saving, and ordering.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single information entry by ID, optionally in a specified language, including associated media and images.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all information entries, optionally filtered by publication status and node, supporting localization.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the 'Info' instance, ensuring required fields like title and text are present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the 'Info' instance to the database, including handling image gallery updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders the entry to appear before others by decreasing its order value.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders the entry to appear after others by increasing its order value.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for a new entry, placing it at the end.
